name: Omega-3 (Fish Oil)
summary: Good for general health, not a muscle-builder. Despite the marketing, the best evidence shows no boost to muscle protein synthesis in healthy adults; any muscle benefit is small and mostly for older or clinical populations.
effect: A 2025 meta-analysis found no effect on muscle protein synthesis rates in healthy adults; a whole-body protein-synthesis signal likely reflects reduced protein breakdown, with the clearest benefits in inflammatory/clinical or older populations, not trained lifters.
dosing: For general cardiovascular/health reasons, ~1-2 g/day combined EPA+DHA. Not required or recommended as a hypertrophy aid.
safety: Generally safe; high doses can mildly thin blood and cause GI upset. Choose third-party-tested products for purity.
